decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line that is very close to the core practice software and likely cheap to continue refining, it is a valuable option to keep open while market feedback develops.

Although a continuing education institute is somewhat less central than software modules, it leverages existing customer relationships and training capabilities, so a growing firm would usually keep it on the market until demand becomes clearer.
The remote support tool directly complements the installed software base and customer service model, and its low expected carrying cost makes continuation the likely choice under real options logic.
